title: Quick Thai Carrot Quesadilla
description: A twist on traditional quesadillas, this Thai-inspired dish combines roasted carrots with a crispy tortilla and creamy sauce. This recipe is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Peel and chop carrots into 1-inch sticks.
Toss carrots with coconut oil, soy sauce, honey, garlic, cumin, and chili flakes. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a pan, warm a tortilla over medium heat.
Place a portion of roasted carrots onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the tortilla is crispy and the filling is heated through.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until crispy and golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with chopped cilantro.
